scripts.db:migrate: env-cmd -f .env pnpm dlx --package=prisma@6.19.2 prisma migrate dev --schema=apps/api/prisma/schema
scripts.db:push: env-cmd -f .env pnpm dlx --package=prisma@6.19.2 prisma db push --schema=apps/api/prisma/schema
scripts.db:pull: env-cmd -f .env pnpm dlx --package=prisma@6.19.2 prisma db pull --schema=apps/api/prisma/schema
